note: Every constant the instrument uses is declared here. Nothing is calibrated, rounded or chosen to fit. A change to any value in this file is a change to the framework and needs an entry in handoff/LOG.md saying why.

Y.role: frozen reference tropical year, in days

alpha.role: the ratio whose continued fraction generates the hard rungs

tau_star.role: natural absorption point, derived by exact integration of dτ = (J_ret/J0) dq; not chosen

launch.note: LAUNCH is the zeroth convergent 0/1. It is a state, not a reduction, and must never be drawn as a rung that integrated nothing.

ladder.derivation: continued fraction convergents of alpha, in BigInt; J_i = |q_i*J0 - p_i*Q| exactly

time.tau: physical Matrix time, in Matrix days
time.civil_time: civil time may drive the display, never τ itself
time.origin: q = 0 is the start of the experiment, not a singularity. Every counter runs live from it.

binding_note: Each constant declares the exact binding site in app.js. A check that only greps for the number would pass while the real binding was changed, because the validation tables repeat the digits.
